failure_mechanism_assessment.confirmed_static_limit: The allowed generation path relies on model knowledge and policy compliance; it has no external factual grounding or reliable whole-entity recognition check. Nonempty, well-formed text can be sent even when its product identity is fabricated.
failure_mechanism_assessment.plausible_not_proven_for_this_request: The model may extrapolate a whole product identity from familiar name fragments and pressure to provide a concise explanation. The exact provider/model/prompt branch and internal cause remain unobserved.
failure_mechanism_assessment.not_a_finding: No evidence here proves that selector, a particular provider/model, the budget gate or provider settings caused A. Reviewer official-page comparison is not a tool the bot had.

minimal_general_repair_advice: First create a separate finite exact-request trace task; do not spend an unplanned thirteenth API read inside this frozen canary or infer the incident path from source alone.

A small shared-policy candidate may address the narrower missing behavior: familiar fragments do not establish the full named entity; failure to recognize a name cannot justify claims that it is unofficial, nonexistent, an OEM/rebrand or marketing label; identity accuracy overrides sentence-count/style requirements. This is a hypothesis to validate, not a completed factual repair.

When identity cannot be supported, state that uncertainty and request one specific identifying source or manufacturer. Do not invent a list of plausible product lines or claim browsing. Honest unknown is safer but remains PARTIAL for the original useful-answer acceptance.

If reliable useful answers to newer named entities require factual retrieval, plan a separate bounded public-source capability with explicit owner, provenance, timeout/size/domain rules, source-injection handling and existing budget integration. Do not silently add retrieval, change selector/model/provider settings or create a new wallet in this repair.

separate_next_tasks.entry_gate: A new bounded read-only contract and independent PRE; exact A chat/message/update/request correlation must come from still-authorized evidence, never invented or obtained by reopening expired data.
separate_next_tasks.suggested_scope: Predeclare account, one dev function/log group, a <=120-second A interval and finite limits. At most identity check plus one exact chat/message log query and one exact correlated request/stream query; no pagination expansion, scans, queue reads, Invoke, model calls or UI. Stop if correlation is missing/ambiguous.
separate_next_tasks.evidence: Existing request/provider/model log fields can prove only what was actually logged. Counts or current source cannot reconstruct a historical full prompt. Preserve UNKNOWN where records are absent.
separate_next_tasks.retention: Register any new trace originals before collection under a separate scope; do not append to the frozen 15-row canary, copy/rebuild its originals or extend its existing deadline. If trace contains derived A content, cap its retention at the original Q deadline.

separate_next_tasks.entry_gate: Use the trace or explicitly retained UNKNOWN to select the smallest shared-owner change; preserve selector/model/provider/budget and original request/retention gates.
separate_next_tasks.evidence: Source diff and local payload regressions are separate from semantic acceptance; require a fresh reviewed bounded model/UI batch and new direct window before real tests. Do not immediately request another window while repair remains unreviewed.

test_requirements: Inspect actual HTTP payloads for Gemini and both existing fallback providers using synthetic transports: shared identity boundary present, original question preserved, no invented web tools/sources, unchanged provider/model/options/budget hooks.

Use a general matrix: known public concept; unfamiliar synthetic entity; ambiguous brand-like short name; user-supplied manufacturer/official excerpt; personal ownership and mixed public/personal question; quoted third-party/instruction-injection text; existing languages and empty/nonempty context.
Production policy must not contain RTX/NVIDIA-specific definitions, fixed answers or keyword-based routing. A named regression input may remain a test case, not an answer lookup.

Preserve useful known-public answers and personal evidence boundaries. Unknown-name cases must not assert nonexistent/nonofficial/rebrand/marketing facts without support; a concise honest unknown does not satisfy the useful-answer PASS gate.

Do not treat substring prompt assertions, fabricated model responses or local mock passes as hallucination resistance. A later bounded real output review must assess full replies against actual permitted sources and preserve FAIL/PARTIAL without prompting until a desired answer appears.
